decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is a core part of the coolant management line and has stayed on the website for two years, so keeping the option open costs little while its value is still being learned.

The cleaning centrifuge complements the coolant system portfolio and shows continued presence, and with uncertainty still unresolved after a short time on the market, abandoning it would be premature.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a standard, broadly demanded product in machine-tool peripherals and remain on the website, which suggests the option is proving its value at low holding cost.
After the magnetic variant was pruned, the hinged belt conveyor remains as one of two retained conveyor options, which signals that management judged its prospects worth continued commitment.
